mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultation_session (id, business_status, description, urgent_latched, prompt_evaluation_latched, human_requested_latched, unsuitable_latched, undetermined, last_message_seq, last_evaluated_seq, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, 1, '', false, false, false, false, false, 0, 0, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, business_status AS status, gender, age, patient_id AS patientId, patient_name AS patientName, duration, description, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM consultation_session WHERE updated_at >= #{fromAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND updated_at < #{toAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_session WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT run_id AS runId, decision_time AS decisionTime FROM consult_match_decision WHERE consultation_id = #{consultationId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY decision_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, business_status AS businessStatus, gender, age, patient_id AS patientId, patient_name AS patientName, account_id AS accountId, title, duration, description, card_json AS cardJson, triage_json AS triageJson, urgent_latched AS urgentLatched, prompt_evaluation_latched AS promptEvaluationLatched, human_requested_latched AS humanRequestedLatched, unsuitable_latched AS unsuitableLatched, undetermined, fallback_reason AS fallbackReason, urgent_template_id AS urgentTemplateId, notice_template_id AS noticeTemplateId, last_message_seq AS lastMessageSeq, last_evaluated_seq AS lastEvaluatedSeq, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM consultation_session WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, business_status AS businessStatus, gender, age, patient_id AS patientId, patient_name AS patientName, account_id AS accountId, title, duration, description, card_json AS cardJson, triage_json AS triageJson, urgent_latched AS urgentLatched, prompt_evaluation_latched AS promptEvaluationLatched, human_requested_latched AS humanRequestedLatched, unsuitable_latched AS unsuitableLatched, undetermined, fallback_reason AS fallbackReason, urgent_template_id AS urgentTemplateId, notice_template_id AS noticeTemplateId, last_message_seq AS lastMessageSeq, last_evaluated_seq AS lastEvaluatedSeq, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, transcript_json AS transcriptJson FROM consultation_session WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.id AS consultationId, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.title, ''), LEFT(s.description, 18), '新的咨询') AS title, s.business_status AS status, s.created_at AS createdAt, s.updated_at AS updatedAt, o.ended_at AS endedAt, o.doctor_name AS doctorName FROM consultation_session s LEFT JOIN consult_order o ON o.consultation_id = s.id AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.account_id = #{accountId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.created_at >= #{fromAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT s.id FROM consultation_session s JOIN consultation_message m ON m.consultation_id = s.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.source = 1 WHERE s.account_id = #{accountId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND m.text = #{text} AND m.received_at >= #{since,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM consult_order o WHERE o.consultation_id = s.id AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.ended_at IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY m.received_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT seq, message_id AS messageId, source, text, received_at AS receivedAt FROM consultation_message WHERE consultation_id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY seq
mapper.update: UPDATE consultation_session SET business_status = #{businessStatus}, service_type = NULL, gender = #{gender,jdbcType=INTEGER}, age = #{age,jdbcType=INTEGER}, patient_id = #{patientId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, patient_name = #{patientName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, account_id = #{accountId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, title = #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, duration = #{duration,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, card_json = #{cardJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, triage_json = #{triageJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, urgent_latched = #{urgentLatched}, prompt_evaluation_latched = #{promptEvaluationLatched}, human_requested_latched = #{humanRequestedLatched}, unsuitable_latched = #{unsuitableLatched}, undetermined = #{undetermined}, fallback_reason = #{fallbackReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, urgent_template_id = #{urgentTemplateId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, notice_template_id = #{noticeTemplateId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, last_message_seq = #{lastMessageSeq}, last_evaluated_seq = #{lastEvaluatedSeq}, updated_at = #{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

INSERT INTO safety_decision_audit (decision_id, consultation_id, message_seq, trigger_type, evaluation, certainty, matched_rule_ids, shadow_rule_ids, model_trigger_ids, evidence_refs, catalog_version, rule_engine_version, model_status, model_version, fallback_reason, previous_status, resulting_status, business_before, business_after, template_id, decision_time, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{decisionId}, #{consultationId}, #{messageSeq}, #{triggerType}, #{evaluation}, #{certainty}, #{matchedRuleIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{shadowRuleIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{modelTriggerIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{evidenceRefs,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{catalogVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ruleEngineVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{modelStatus}, #{modelVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fallbackReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{previousStatus}, #{resultingStatus}, #{businessBefore}, #{businessAfter}, #{templateId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{decisionTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{decisionTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{decisionTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 0)

INSERT INTO consult_match_decision (decision_id, run_id, consultation_id, order_id, message_seq, trigger_type, node, certainty, source, reason_code, output_json, evidence_refs, shadow_ids, model_status, model_cached, model_latency_ms, latency_ms, catalog_version, prompt_version, model_name, input_fingerprint, decision_time, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{decisionId}, #{runId}, #{consultationId}, #{orderId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{messageSeq}, #{triggerType}, #{node}, #{certainty}, #{source}, #{reasonCode}, #{outputJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{evidenceRefs,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{shadowIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{modelStatus,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{modelCached,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, #{modelLatencyMs,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{latencyMs}, #{catalogVersion}, #{promptVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{modelName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{inputFingerprint}, #{decisionTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{decisionTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{decisionTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT node, source, reason_code AS reasonCode, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN model_status IS NOT NULL AND model_status <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS modelCalls, COALESCE(AVG(model_latency_ms), 0) AS avgLatency FROM consult_match_decision WHERE decision_time >= #{fromAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY node, source, reason_code ORDER BY node, total DESC

mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS consultationId, o.id AS orderId, o.paid_at AS paidAt, o.package_code AS packageCode, s.card_specialty AS specialty FROM consult_order o JOIN consultation_session s ON s.id = o.consultation_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.pay_status = 2 AND o.doctor_id IS NULL AND o.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY o.paid_at ASC, o.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
